quests.name: Short on Raw Salmon
quests.summary: The banker of Draelford has run out of raw salmon.
intro: My stores are bare. I need 14 raw salmon and nobody in Draelford has any to spare.
Bring them to me, however you come by them.
outro: That will keep me going for a good while. Take this for your trouble.

quests.name: A Parcel for the Barber
quests.summary: Carry a parcel across Draelford to the barber.
intro: This should have gone to the barber days ago and I cannot leave my post.
Take it over for me and come back when it is done.
outro: Delivered and settled? Good. Here is something for the legwork.

lines: player: A delivery from the general store keeper.
At last. I had begun to think it lost. Tell them the account is settled.

quests.name: Word to the Food Shop Keeper
quests.summary: Call on the food shop keeper of Draelford and bring back their answer.
intro: I need an answer from the food shop keeper and I would rather not shout it across the street.
Call on them as a customer, then ask how our accounts stand.
outro: Balanced? Then I can sleep tonight. My thanks.

lines: player: The barber sent me to ask after the ledgers.
Tell them the figures balance, for once. There is nothing owed between us this season.

quests.name: Eyes on the Draelford Sewers
quests.summary: Climb down into Draelford Sewers and report what you see.
intro: Something has been scratching under the streets at night. It comes from Draelford Sewers.
Go down the entrance, take a look around and come back in one piece.
outro: So it is as bad as I feared. Thank you for looking, that took nerve.

quests.name: Trouble with Bats
quests.summary: The archery shop keeper wants the bat near Draelford thinned out.
intro: The bat beyond the walls grow bolder every week. Customers will not walk the road.
Put down 9 of them close to Draelford and I will make it worth your while.
outro: The road is quieter already. Here, as promised.

quests.name: Short on Bones
quests.summary: The magic shop keeper of Draelford has run out of bones.
intro: My stores are bare. I need 11 bones and nobody in Draelford has any to spare.
Bring them to me, however you come by them.
outro: That will keep me going for a good while. Take this for your trouble.

quests.name: Supply Run to Brackenholt
quests.summary: Gather willow logs for the banker, then carry a shipment to Brackenholt.
intro: I have an order from Brackenholt and nothing to fill it with.
Bring me 18 willow logs, then take the packed shipment to the banker there and do some business while you are in town.
outro: They took the lot? Then we have a trade route. Your share, as agreed.

lines: player: Goods from the banker in Draelford.
From Draelford? Then the roads are open after all. Set it down there.

quests.name: The Long Hunt
quests.summary: Hunt the creatures around Draelford and bring back willow logs.
intro: The wilds around Draelford need a firm hand. Start with 9 giant spider outside the walls, then 14 king scorpion down in Draelford Sewers.
When that is done, bring me 18 willow logs to show for it.
outro: A proper hunt. The town will eat and sleep easier for it.

quests.name: Votes for the Council
quests.summary: Gather support around Draelford for the barber.
intro: The council meets soon and I am short of friends.
Speak to the realtor, carry whatever they give you, and see that the paperwork is lodged.
outro: Agreed, all of them? You have a talent for this. Here.

lines: player: The barber asks whether you will stand with them at the next council.
I will, if the clothes shop keeper does. Take this sealed note over and we shall see.
player: A sealed note, from the realtor.
Hm. They want my vote. Very well, tell your employer it is agreed.

quests.name: Sweeping the Draelford Sewers
quests.summary: Clear king scorpion out of Draelford Sewers and tell the food shop keeper.
intro: Draelford Sewers is crawling with king scorpion, and they come up through the drains.
Go down, kill 14 of them, then let the food shop keeper know their cellar is safe.
outro: Both done? Draelford owes you more than I can pay, but take this.

lines: player: Draelford Sewers is clearer than it was. 14 king scorpion fewer.
Then the cellars on this street are safe a while longer. I will tell the others.

quests.name: The Draelford Trade Route
quests.summary: Open a trade route between Draelford and Brackenholt.
intro: I mean to open a trade route to Brackenholt. It needs a contract carried, a road made safe and a courier who is proven underground.
Deliver the contract, trade there, cut down 22 bat near our walls and prove yourself in the dungeoneering caves.
Then have the banker underwrite the venture.
outro: Signed, safe and funded. You have changed the fortunes of this town.
Here is your cut of the first season.

lines: player: A contract from the general store keeper in Draelford.
A fair offer. But the road between us is not safe, and you know it.
player: The route to Brackenholt is open and the contract is signed.
Then I will underwrite it. Draelford has not had news this good in years.

quests.name: The Thing Beneath Draelford
quests.summary: Find what rules Draelford Sewers, weaken its nest and destroy The Ooze Mother.
intro: Something rules Draelford Sewers and it is getting stronger. I want it gone.
Ask the realtor what they have heard, see it for yourself, then come back and we will decide how to break the nest.
When it is weak, kill it and tell the banker.
outro: I felt the ground go still. Draelford is yours to walk freely, friend.
Take this. It is everything I promised and a little more.

lines: player: Have you heard anything from below the streets?
Every night. Something large is down there, and the small ones answer to it. They call it The Ooze Mother.
So you have seen it. We can thin them by force, or I can have the guard hold the drains if they are supplied.
steps.prompt: How will you weaken the nest?

options.text: I will cut them down myself.
Supply the guard and let them hold the drains.

lines: player: The Ooze Mother is dead. Draelford Sewers is quiet.
Then the vaults are safe and so is everyone above them. The town will hear of this.

quests.name: The Fall of the Broodmother
quests.summary: March on Stonejaw Depths, break its creatures and bring down The Broodmother.
intro: Stonejaw Depths has stood against Draelford for too long. The Broodmother sits at the bottom of it.
Learn what you can from the general store keeper, fight your way through 22 giant spider and end The Broodmother.
Bring 14 raw trout back so the town can rebuild.
outro: It is done, then. They will sing about this in every tavern from here to the coast.
Take your reward. You have more than earned it.

lines: player: What do you know of Stonejaw Depths?
Only that those who go in come back thin and quiet. The Broodmother rules it now.
player: Word from Draelford: The Broodmother is dead.
Dead? Then the caravans can leave at dawn. This news is worth more than gold.
